name: CRISPR-Ops demo panel
description: 20-guide x 3-population audit panel. HBB, CCR5, and PCSK9 spacers are 20-nt GRCh38 sequences derived from NGG PAM sites in each gene body.

guides.note: Published HBB exon-1 spacer against the reference allele. GRCh38 hit is chr11:5226984 with PAM AGG.
Plus-strand NGG site in HBB exon 1 on GRCh38 (PAM CGG). Locus-derived candidate.
Minus-strand NGG site at the HBB promoter on GRCh38 (window chr11:5227090, PAM GGG). Locus-derived candidate.
